description.value: A cultured multi-chamber stomach. You need only a quarter the normal food; you last three times as long before a starvation clock starts; once per day you can spend 10 minutes "chewing over" an ingested poison you've taken to end it.

cinderfall.incomplete: None of the three clauses have a rule-element hook: pf2e has no hunger/food-clock mechanism anywhere to reduce (confirmed absence -- metabolic-control.json ships an equally concrete 'no need to eat' claim with rules: []), and 'spend 10 minutes to end an ingested poison' is a limited-use activated ability that needs a granted Action, not a rule element.
